name: connector.hello
title: Version and capability negotiation
summary: The first and only frame allowed before negotiation completes. Not a status call: it exists so the extension can refuse to send anything a Connector might misread. Subsumes connector.version for negotiation purposes.

capabilities.description: Names this Connector will honour, and nothing else. protocol/compatibility-rules.json#/capabilities is the single normative registry: a command may cite only names declared there, and the recorded hello in protocol/fixtures/protocol/handshake.jsonl must announce exactly that set. scripts/verify.mjs asserts both directions, so the registry cannot grow a name no Connector reports nor report a name the registry never declared.

jobObjectAvailable.description: Windows: whether Core can be contained so it cannot outlive the Connector. False is a warning, not a failure (docs/architecture/30).
